paragraphs.text: Robert Gabriel Mugabe International Airport (HRE/FVRG) serves as a key air gateway for Harare, ZW, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 05/23: 4725 m (15502 ft) asphalt.
Ground transportation options connecting Robert Gabriel Mugabe International Airport with central Harare include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from HRE should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Robert Gabriel Mugabe International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Robert Gabriel Mugabe International Airport is HRE and the ICAO code is FVRG.

faqs.q: Which city does HRE airport serve?
faqs.a: Robert Gabriel Mugabe International Airport (HRE) serves Harare, ZW.
